original_clauses.source_paraphrase: Google reported that Gemini's diversity tuning overcompensated in historically specific contexts and also produced over-broad refusals on benign requests.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A protective tuning control must activate only in contexts that satisfy its applicability conditions and remain calibrated to the specific representational task.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Protective and diversity tuning became operative in historically specific or benign contexts where Google says it should not have applied, producing inaccurate images and over-broad refusals.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: The safety control activated, but Google later said it was being triggered in contexts where that response was inappropriate.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Control activation and the validity of the trigger that justified activation are separate questions.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The diversity and safety control did activate; the defect was that it operated in contexts where Google says the trigger conditions were inappropriate, cleanly distinguishing activation failure from activation validity.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: Google launched people-image generation in the Gemini conversational app using Imagen 2. It described tuning intended to avoid harmful images and broaden representation.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The product, intended function and safeguard purpose precede the observed tuning defect.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: Google reported that representation tuning overcompensated in historically or culturally specific requests, while excessive caution caused benign prompts to be refused. These were different reported effects, not two descriptions of separate identical requests.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A safeguard must become operative on a valid trigger and applicability basis; inappropriate activation differs from absent activation.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: After user feedback, Google temporarily disabled generation of people and said it would improve and extensively test the feature before restoring it.
